主要内容: On February 2, 2016, Citibank Global Markets Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC notified Novavax, Inc. of their election to purchase $25 million aggregate principal amount of the Company’s 3.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2023 under the over-allotment option. The Additional Notes were issued on February 5, 2016, under the same indenture as the Company’s 3.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2023 issued on January 29, 2016. In connection with the offering, the Company entered into additional capped call transactions with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, London Branch and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC. The Company paid the Option Counterparties approximately $2.89 million for the additional capped call transactions. The Additional Capped Call Transactions cover 3,670,533 shares of Novavax common stock, with an initial strike price of approximately $6.81 per share and a cap price of approximately $9.73 per share. The Additional Capped Call Transactions are subject to anti-dilution adjustments and certain adjustments under the terms of the Additional Capped Call Transactions.

股票实体.名称: JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, London Branch
